properties.title: NRC Report: Ferric Sulfate in Storm Drain near Totowa, NJ
properties.summary: Incident Type: MOBILE - NRC Report ID: 989823 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: QUALITY CARRIERS
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 989823
Incident Time: 2011-09-16 13:10:00
Nearest City: Totowa, NJ
Incident Type: MOBILE
Material: FERRIC SULFATE
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: QUALITY CARRIERS
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 10 gallons
ON SEPTEMBER 16, 2011, A TRUCKING COMPANY CONTACTED ERTS TO MANAGE A FERRIC SULFATE UN3264 RELEASE. ERTS DISPATCHED AN ENVIRONMENTAL CONTRACTOR (ATLANTIC RESPONSE) TO THE SITE FOR CLEAN UP OPERATIONS. A TRACTOR TANKER WAS OFF LOADING FERRIC SULFATE UN3264 AND WAS COMPLETING THE OFF LOAD PROCESS AND SPRAYED THE MATERIAL FROM THE HOSE ONTO THE WALL OF THE BUILDING AND THE BAY DOOR. THE RELEASED MATERIAL IMPACTED AN AREA OF THE CONCRETE DRIVEWAY MEASURING APPROXIMATELY 25' BY 25', WHICH CONSISTS OF A THIN LAYER OF MATERIAL. THE RELEASED MATERIAL ALSO IMPACTED A NEARBY STORM DRAIN, BUT IS CONTAINED INSIDE THE CATCH BASIN AT THIS TIME. THE CONTRACTOR UTILIZED ABSORBENTS TO COLLECT THE RELEASED MATERIAL FROM THE IMPACTED STORM DRAIN AND ALSO NEUTRALIZED THE REST OF THE RELEASED MATERIAL, COLLECTED ALL OF THE WASTE AND CONTAINERIZE IT FOR DISPOSAL ACTIVITIES.
